basics.name: Krisu Aho
basics.label: Tech Lead / Product Manager / Senior Full-Stack Architect / UX
basics.summary:
Krisu Aho is a happy and skillful fellow that can make broad kinds of ideas come true also at the business level. He has 28 years of extensive service development experience in various roles including full-stack development, UX design, team lead, strategy and architecture design.

Understanding teams, services and businesses also at the deeper level has always been one of Krisu’s strengths. Krisu has experience in both - building teams from scratch and jumping on the “moving train” with existing teams and practices.
basics.x-tagline: Krisu cares about building great products and services – and about growing the teams and the business along the way. Products, teams and business growth at the heart of it all.

work.name: Kipinä Software Oy
work.position: Tech Lead / Product Manager / Senior Full-Stack Architect / UX

projects.name: AI chat interface
projects.description:
Developing an AI chat interface (an AI agent product) for customers to access all available AI generated data.

EcoSignal AI excels at converting sustainability data into business and collaboration through AI. Krisu started in January, studied the old legacy service, found many ways to improve the old solutions and developed many new wished features. The biggest improvements so far have been the complete rewrite of the legacy system to support modern enterprise solutions and developing the AI chat interface. Adding support for desktop and mobile was also a big improvement as the service was earlier only for browser. On top of developing, Krisu has also helped greatly in sales, strategy, design and UX.
projects.x-note: The 'Story' text of the highlight slide covers both projects for this client; it is attached here.

projects.name: ESG Product development
projects.description: Upgrading an old legacy product into a full enterprise service for desktop, web and mobile.

projects.name: Aggregation Platform
projects.description:
The client's backend for multi-tenant gaming services for national and international markets. Architecting the client's platform into the international format with their products and services. International team building, development management, cross-team work and guiding changes. 2 tech-teams: Product & Delivery, Scrum, Strategy, Presentations, Team Lead, Key metrics (KPI's).

Krisu has been a Development Manager at Arpa Oy for 2 years, full-time. His responsibility has been to manage three different international development teams, be responsible for the architecture and build a strategy that has taken Arpa Oy to foreign markets. He has been a strategically very important key player, developing the client's entire technical capabilities for foreign markets and delivering products and services to different countries. He has driven major team and system reforms in co-operation with the client's managers, which have also included difficult organizational reforms and layoffs. Long-term architecture is definitely Krisu's trump card and he is always able to see the impact of even small things on a large scale. Krisu gets along really easily with all kinds of people and can take charge of situations and things quickly and smoothly - in Finnish or English.

projects.name: Backoffice Suite
projects.description: The client's frontend for international markets with a highly scalable management portal for national and international markets. Building the team and platform from scratch. Development management, cross-team work, code, integrations, cloud and guiding changes. Scrum, Agile, Kanban, Strategy, Presentations, Design, Key metrics (KPI's).

projects.name: Investor Services
projects.description:
Customer portal for analysing and predicting copyright performances and portfolios globally. Target market was investors who want to invest in music and need to valuate assets. Integrated with the existing copyright, statistics (big data) and financial data handling products to produce interactive and standalone visual reports.

Planning, Coding, Databases, DevOps, Cloud handling, Big Data and Integrations. International team building, development management, cross-team work and guiding changes. Architecture, integrations and service design. Scrum, Strategy, Presentations, Team Lead, Key metrics (KPI's).

projects.name: Distribution Services
projects.description: Artist portal for handling marketing, sales, registrations, social media and others. Visual tool for creating different types of campaigns and seeing their performance automatically when launched. Upgrading the frontend with modern tech according to the new design.

projects.name: Financial Services
projects.description: Customizable white label loan service for many types of music industries, where artists can get advances on their single song or whole portfolio. Money available is based on the assets and how they have been performing the last 6+ months. Trusted predictions are made from future income with Facebook's prediction engine and added margin of error. Artists are then guided through KYC and bank registration to be able to withdraw the calculated money. Can be integrated as a ready-made service or through an API platform. Planning and setting up the payment gateway with Globalbank and integrating it as a microservice into the product.

projects.name: Internal company portal
projects.description:
Easy to use company portal (an internal people directory) for finding all internal information easily. Included: Offices, People, Projects, Sales, CV's, Allocations and Feeds. Cherry on the top was the advanced dynamic "Google-like" search with super fast results and visual feedback.

Orchestrating all internal systems into one by developing dynamic architecture for the company.
